Underwriting Guidelines:
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses with frequent or severe claims, especially those related to product liability,
equipment malfunction, or bodily injury.
– Operations demonstrating poor maintenance practices, inadequate loss control programs,
or failure to comply with applicable health and safety regulations.
– Stores dealing extensively in unverified or uncertified medical equipment, or those lacking
proper licensing or accreditation.
Key Risk Considerations
Medical and hospital supply stores face several unique risks that
must be carefully evaluated:
• Slip-and-Fall Hazards: Due to customer foot traffic and the presence of equipment or
supplies in aisles, stores must maintain clean, well-lit, and unobstructed premises to reduce
liability.
• Rental Equipment Risks: When stores rent out medical devices (e.g., wheelchairs, oxygen
tanks), risks include improper use, equipment malfunction, and inadequate sanitization, which
can lead to bodily injury claims.
